structure.unit: Sale of Ephedrine or Related Compounds

law.catch_line: Exemption from participation in electronic system; requirement to maintain log
law.text: Any pharmacy or retail distributor that has been granted an exemption from participation in the system pursuant to subsection B of § 18.2-265.8 shall forward to the Department every seven days by fax or electronic means a legible copy of the log required by § 18.2-265.7.
